desc: Is Paper Mario 64's Bowser fair in the story? His fight after the credits in the east side's yard (gor_02) at the full run's level-25 Mario (45 HP, 40 FP, Ultra Boots and Hammer, every Star Power with a full gauge, Goombella to Flurrie at Ultra rank, a bag of 5 Super and 3 Ultra Shrooms), with NORMAL damage (no god mode) and no badges: the auto battler's attacks with their action commands and guards (TTYD_AUTO_BATTLE_ASSIST=2: with 0 or 1 it presses nothing, 3 or 4 a hit at level 25, and no Mario RPG's last boss falls to that), a Star Power only to break his Star Rod barrier (versus_cpu_aurora.c foeBehindBarrier), items when low. Scaled to 96% of PM64's own (95 HP of 99), his barrier broken, his Recover only while Mario is ahead by 25 points of HP share as PM64's (it was every time below half: 87 HP back), he must lose inside the turn cap. Pending (2026-11-09): kept out of the round by the user's call (keep the balance, tweak later). At 120 turns with Appeal the auto battler loses after Bowser's turn 32 with Bowser at 34/95 (no badges); 0.5.1 balance pass. Groups were pm64, pm64_story, pm64run
